svg.title: ThingsBoard release-3.6 - failure recovery and observability

g.text: process dies before save; entity lost from JVM
process dies before future.set; upstream may replay
outer catch: failed++ / concurrency-- / debug log
taskCtx.future is not completed with setException.
The caller future may remain pending forever.
RE tmp/final counters and optional timers
debug/error event when enabled and not limited
audit action when enabled by mask
but AtomicInteger log windows remain. Gauge/Timer registration follows their
own call paths. Prometheus also requires actuator endpoint exposure.
There is no common end-to-end trace, durable attempt ledger, Actor mailbox gauge,
application DLQ, SQL oldest-age metric, or unified provider async-ack failure metric.
Debug Event and Audit are fallible side channels, not completion receipts.
